SELECT s.id, s.code, s.name, s.status, s.remark, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_price_scheme_item i WHERE i.scheme_id = s.id) AS item_count FROM scm_price_scheme s
(s.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND s.status = #{status}
ORDER BY s.code
